keyPhrases.text: If you embrace the overkill, you'll enjoy it
knife-sharp screenplay, packed tightly with petty put-downs and witty retorts, is terrific
histrionics are so loud it feels more like a 1950s melodrama
There's ample reward in watching so much talent chewing so much scenery
if you have a taste for the decadent, sit back, settle in and appreciate the insanity of it all

reasoning: Mixed review that acknowledges significant flaws (over-the-top performances, miscasting, melodramatic tone) while praising elements like the screenplay and star power. Offers conditional recommendation based on viewer preferences for excess/decadence.
